name: gi-connected-party-pricing-and-interest
description: Gibraltar connected-party pricing and financing reference under Income Tax Act Schedule 4. Covers profit adjustments, excess interest, conditional thin capitalisation, the aggregate connected-expense cap, Commissioner-satisfied exemption and shareholder-loan deemed distributions and statutory advance-clearance procedure. Includes separate numerical examples and evidence controls, without treating any one threshold as a safe harbour. Based on the March 2026 statutory consolidation checked in October 2026. Adds the ordinary Schedule 4 Part V net-borrowing-cost limit and carry-forward rules. Complex control attribution, the specified exemption cross-reference, international reporting and independent professional review remain outstanding.
